# Security & Compliance Policy

## Supported Baseline

| Component / Node | Environment | Security Status |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `FN-WORKSTATION` | Windows 11 Pro 25H2 (Build 26200) | Active & Hardened (HVCI Enforced) |
| `userfn-git/main` | Primary Engineering Hub | Actively Maintained |

## Kernel & Anti-Cheat Compliance (`EOS`)

All input pipelines, telemetry bridges, and physics utilities documented in this repository adhere strictly to user-mode Windows Internals (`RawInput`, `DirectInput`, `Shared Memory IPC`) and Easy Anti-Cheat (`EOS`) compliance guidelines.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Do not open public issues for security vulnerabilities or sensitive hardware identifiers. Report directly via email to **`fnprospace@gmail.com`** with reproduction steps and system logs.
